concerns.text: FR-001 defines the estimator as $k_{est} = |\Delta 	au| / |\Delta v|$. The upstream idea explicitly identifies a 'confounding variable of normal force' which invalidates this construct. The spec fails to address this by either (a) modifying the formula to include normal force (e.g., $|\Delta 	au| / (|\Delta v| \cdot N)$) or (b) explicitly controlling for normal force in the experimental design. Without this, the spec validates a flawed proxy, failing the core research question.

The spec defines 'zero-shot' adaptation but fails to define the 'training distribution' or the mechanism ensuring test objects are truly unseen. The upstream idea flagged this as a validity risk: if friction randomization (0.1-1.2) overlaps with training, the 'zero-shot' claim is false. The spec must explicitly define the domain shift (e.g., 'Training friction range: 0.4-0.6; Test range: 0.1-1.2') to validate the research question.

The spec references 'T030' regarding missing documentation (README.md, docs/) in the 'Tasks an independent verifier REJECTED' block, but the spec itself does not include a Functional Requirement (FR) or User Story mandating the creation of these documentation artifacts. The spec must include an FR (e.g., 'System MUST generate a README.md documenting the estimator logic') to ensure the documentation requirement is captured in the scope.
